Bug-fix verification · vc-frontend PR #2588

VCST-6375: cart "Price per item" now matches on wide and narrow layouts

VERIFIED WITH NOTESLocal PR build · not deployed to QASTR 3/3 on fixed build

When a promotion reward has "Round amount per item" unchecked, the cart line comes back with showPlacedPrice = false. The wide layout showed the list price; the narrow layout (line-items container ≤ 56rem) showed the discounted price. The fix makes the narrow slot in VcLineItem follow the same rule.

  1. PASSBug reproduced on the pre-fix qa1 storefront at 1280 and 390.
  2. PASSFixed build shows the list price in the narrow and mobile slot, 3 of 3 runs.

  5. PASSLine with showPlacedPrice = true (vodka without the coupon, sale 237.00) still shows 237.00 in the narrow slot.
  6. PASSWishlist at 1280: sale 237.00 → list 400.00 (accepted side effect).

Notes

  • Verified against a local build of the unmerged PR. Re-run after merge and deploy before moving the ticket to Tested.
  • Wishlists and quotes now show the list price at narrow widths as well, matching their wide column. Product should confirm this is the intended behaviour.
  • The non-coupon promotion "QA Category Percent" (rounding off) is never applied to cart lines on qa1, so the coupon CAT20 promotion was used instead (no promotion edited).
  • Separate issue, not filed: for a buyer with several named carts, /cart shows the newest named cart while remove-item and add-coupon act on the default cart.
